name: codeclash
description: CodeClash — live coding and quiz contests

scripts.predev: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w judge && npm run build -w agent
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,judge,agent,client -c black,black,black,black "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w judge" "npm run dev -w agent" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w judge && npm run build -w agent && npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w agent && npm run test -w judge && npm run test -w server
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w packages/shared && npm run test:coverage -w agent && npm run test:coverage -w server && npm run test:coverage -w judge
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w judge && npm run build -w agent && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w judge && npm run typecheck -w agent && npm run typecheck -w client
